Who it's for

Made for small neighbourhood businesses

If your customers look you up on their phone and find nothing — or just a social media page — this page is for you.

Hair and braiding salons

Your services and prices shown clearly, your hours up to date, and your clients book on WhatsApp without interrupting you while you work.

Restaurants

Your menu, your hours and your address on Google Maps. Your customers know where you are and what you serve, before they come.

Beauty and nails

Your treatments, your prices and your best photos in one place. Your clients write to you straight from the page to book.

Your page

Everything your customers are looking for, on a single page

Not a big complicated website. One clear page that opens fast on a phone, with just what it takes for someone to call or write to you.

Your services and prices

What you offer, with your prices. Your customers see the prices before calling — so you don't have to repeat the same thing ten times a day.

Your hours

Your opening hours always visible, including holidays if you share them with us.

Your address and Google Maps

A built-in map and directions in one tap: your customers find your door without getting lost.

Your WhatsApp

In one tap, your customers open a WhatsApp chat with you. They write to you, you reply when you can.

One-tap calling

On a phone, one tap is enough to call you. No number to copy down.

Your photos

Your dishes, your hairstyles, your work in photos. People see what you do before they come.

Your social media, at the bottom of the page

Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, X: your page links to your accounts. You keep your social media, and you also get a page Google can find.

How it works

Simple, in three steps

Three steps, and you decide at the end: you see the result first, with your real information.

1

We prepare your demo

We build your page with your business name, your services, your prices, your hours and your photos. You receive it and look at it on your phone, just as your customers will see it.

Free demo, no commitment
2

You only pay if you love it

Like the demo? You pay and we put the page online. Don't like it? You pay nothing, and we leave it there.

3

Online within 48 hours

Your page is published at your own web address. You share it with your customers, you add it to your social media, and it stays there — even when you're closed.

Frequently asked questions

What people often ask us

What if I don't like the demo?
You pay nothing. The demo is free with no commitment: you decide once you see the result, not based on a promise.
How long before my website is online?
48 hours after your approval and payment. You receive your page’s address, ready to share with your customers and on your social media.
What's included in the 29 $ per month maintenance?
Your page stays online and you get 2 changes per month: change a price, adjust hours, replace a photo, add a service. The first 3 months are free.
What if I need an extra change?
Each extra change costs 9 $.
I'm already on Facebook or Instagram — isn't that enough?
Your social media is still useful for your followers, and you keep it: it’s at the bottom of your page, so your customers can follow you there too. But when a new customer searches Google for “braiding salon near me”, it’s your website they’ll find — with your hours, your address and your WhatsApp, no account needed.
What information do you need from me for the demo?
Your business name, your services and prices, your hours, your address and a few photos if you have some. Write to us by email and we’ll tell you exactly what to send us.

Contact us

Ask for your free demo: just tell us what kind of business you have. We’ll reply, tell you what we need, and your demo will follow — no commitment.
